blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified USG source exposes burnDebt(address,uint256), callable by owner-managed burner roles, and burns from the supplied address without holder allowance. That is direct holder-balance burn/seizure authority.

oracleRisk.summary: Tangent has 12 debt-bearing USG markets and one staged zero-cap msETH/WETH market that remains unpaused, callable, and collateral-holding. Each outer oracle requires Curve LP/component calls, so the end-to-end route is standard-external even where Chainlink leaves have heartbeat-checked fallback and last-good behavior.

branchApplicability.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 25531905, all 13 authorized USG markets remained unpaused and callable. Twelve had positive debt and debt caps. The staged msETH/WETH market 0x7b1b38cad63B0715A0adFeEB75E46431b48E73B6 had a zero debt cap, zero debt shares, and zero bad debt but held 288.932208501029515818 collateral tokens, so it is retained as the thirteenth branch rather than excluded.

branches.fallbackBehavior: Chainlink leaves use configured fallback and then lastGoodValue in no-fail liquidation mode. Mandatory outer Curve get_virtual_price and any recursive price_oracle call are not covered by that cache; either Curve call can revert the complete market price path.
branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless immediate liquidation below health 1 transfers collateral directly or sells it through the zapping proxy. The 20% fee applies only to positive liquidation profit, is minted to the fee treasury, and is added to the liquidator's USG burn requirement.
branches.backstop: No funded Stability Pool is used. If collateral value falls below debt, permissionless seizure sends collateral to the fee treasury and records market bad debt; anyone may burn USG through repayBadDebt.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Owner pauses can stop deposits, borrowing, and leverage but not liquidation or seizure. Recorded bad debt counts against the market debt cap until repaid.
